statement: A read-only, re-runnable EDA script exists at scripts/analysis/lum403-trajectory-signals/ that computes all three trajectory features from prod HookEvent/Session data — (1) per-session consecutive repeated-action n-gram rate, (2) same-file repeated-read-without-write ratio, (3) step/event-count distribution relative to baseline — stratified by LUM-397 outcome labels (MERGED_VERIFIED / MERGED-unverified / unresolved), and writes a stdout summary plus out/report.json; `--check` mode validates the report contains per-stratum sample sizes and all three feature blocks and exits non-zero otherwise
The analysis issues no database writes: the script source contains no Prisma mutation calls (create/update/upsert/delete/executeRaw/transaction-with-writes), verified by a static scan

For each of the three features the report quantifies discriminative power with per-stratum n, distribution stats (median/p90), and a rank-based effect size (Cliff's delta or AUC) between outcome strata — not just raw means
checkpointer: node -e "const r=require('./scripts/analysis/lum403-trajectory-signals/out/report.json');const f=['repeatedActionNgram','sameFileReadNoWrite','stepCount'];for(const k of f){const b=r.features[k];if(!b)throw new Error('missing '+k);if(!b.byStratum||!b.effectSizes)throw new Error(k+' lacks byStratum/effectSizes')}console.log('OK')"

statement: The written findings are actionable and honest: for each signal a clear verdict on whether it discriminates outcome strata in Lumo's data, explicit caveats on sample sizes (especially the thin unresolved stratum and the small MERGED_VERIFIED stratum), and concrete recommended mount points (or an explicit recommendation against) for a follow-up online stuck-detection task
